_说明: viewer3d.html?model=kelly_residence 的清单（标准档 + 低档 glb）。坐标 = glTF（Y 朝上，米）。由 blender/landmarks/kelly_residence/build.py + blender/landmarks/export_glb.py 生成；云海、岩体底座、远处浮岛、结界微光（bg_*）只在成图里。

credit.zh: 自建模型；贴图 Poly Haven / ambientCG（CC0）
credit.en: Own model; textures Poly Haven / ambientCG (CC0)

desc.zh: 两层白灰泥主楼：首层是水平分缝的仿石灰泥，深色勒脚；上层白框推拉窗配细窗格；檐口后是浅坡板岩四坡顶，烟囱在两端。形制为仓库推断（参考塞津科特庄园与摄政公园周边别墅）。
desc.en: A two-storey white-stucco main block: channelled rusticated stucco on the ground floor over a dark plinth, fine-barred sash windows above, and a shallow slate hipped roof behind the cornice with end chimneys. The form is a repo inference (refs: Sezincote, Regent's Park villas).

desc.zh: 正门前四根带卷涡柱头的立柱，檐部分为额枋、檐壁与带齿饰的檐口，上面是二楼的阳台。
desc.en: Four columns with volute capitals before the front door; the entablature is split into architrave, frieze and dentilled cornice, carrying a first-floor balcony.

desc.zh: 侧立面两层通高的弓形凸窗，自带弧形檐口，顶上是板岩半锥顶和铅皮脊。
desc.en: A two-storey bow on the side elevation with its own curved cornice and a slate half-cone roof with lead rolls.

desc.zh: 主楼西侧较低的服务翼：厨房、储藏与仆役用房。
desc.en: A lower service wing west of the main block: kitchen, stores and staff rooms.

desc.zh: 花园一侧的铸铁廊台，细柱与铜顶。
desc.en: A cast-iron verandah on the garden side with slender posts and a copper roof.

desc.zh: 碎石前庭中央的圆形喷泉池，四周是修剪成圆锥和圆柱形的紫杉。
desc.en: A round fountain basin in the gravel forecourt, ringed by clipped yew cones and columns.

desc.zh: 红砖围墙里的菜畦与玻璃温室；草坪上有环岛碎石步道和修剪紫杉。
desc.en: Vegetable beds and a glasshouse inside red-brick walls; a gravel walk circles the lawn among clipped yews.

desc.zh: 岛上成片的橡树和几棵平展分层的雪松。
desc.en: Oak planting around the island with a few layered cedars.

desc.zh: 岛西缘外挑的私家悬浮车停机坪，桥上有铸铁候机小亭；一条碎石车道直通前庭。悬浮岛之间没有公共交通，这是宅邸唯一的出入口。
desc.en: A private hover-vehicle pad cantilevered off the western rim, with a small cast-iron waiting kiosk on the bridge and a gravel drive straight to the forecourt. There is no public transport between islands; this is the house's only way in or out.
